exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Can do (Verb + ことができる)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ることができる matches "Can do (Verb + ことができる)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ることができる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses ability or possibility to do something; means "can" or "be able to."
